status_contract: Counts every official vendored lane-local test-* JS/CJS/MJS fixture, then compares that denominator to the documented manifested passed subset plus explicit lane classification catalogs. Supported lanes use non-ignored Rust tests that execute node-compat fixtures for the matching lane minus explicit expected-failure, known-gap, and skipped classifications as the passed numerator. Ignored watchpoints never count as passed. Expected failures, known gaps, and skipped/excluded entries are not pass claims; the remaining remainder is intentionally reported as unmanifested_or_unclassified, not as pass or fail. Supplementary, regression, canary, watchpoint, and diagnostic evidence is reported in separate evidence tiers and never changes official pass denominators.

evidence_tier_summary.notes: Byte-identical Node upstream test-* fixtures under lane-local nodeNN/test roots; pass percentages use only this denominator.
Nimbus-authored support fixtures that explain behavior beyond official Node corpus pass claims.
Nimbus-authored or adapted regression fixtures separated from official lane roots.
Package and app probes that support developer-facing claims without changing official fixture denominators.
Ignored Rust watchpoints and expectation catalog entries used to preserve known failures and unexpected-pass diagnostics.
Expected-denial or host-owned evidence; these are explicit boundaries, not compatibility passes.
